faq.audienceAnswer: For small business owners, creators, and social media managers who want to create content and manage Instagram in one place. Start with a simple idea, a product photo, or content you already have.
faq.demoAnswer: This preview is an interactive demo with sample data. Trying ideas, viewing schedules, or sending demo replies won't create content or send messages to real Instagram accounts.
faq.accountAnswer: Use an Instagram Business or Creator account. Connect through Instagram's official flow in Carousely settings and grant the permissions needed for publishing and messaging.
faq.startAnswer: Create a free account, connect Instagram, and set up your brand. New accounts get 3 free credits (1 post = 3 credits) and 3 Mimo messages to try it out. After that, choose Pro or Max to keep going.
faq.aiAnswer: No. AI output is a starting point for you to review and edit. You decide which content to use and when to schedule it.

costs.title: The hidden costs of buying a home
costs.alt0: Cover: Thought the house price was all you needed? There are other costs
costs.alt1: The house price is not the total cost of buying; extra costs run about 5–7%
costs.alt2: First cost: BPHTB transfer tax, the largest one, usually 5%
costs.alt3: Second cost: PPAT or notary fees for the sale deed and title transfer
costs.alt4: Closing: talk to a RE/MAX agent first

inspect.title: 4 things to check before you sign
inspect.alt0: Cover: Before you sign, check these 4 things
inspect.alt1: Number 01, roof and ceiling: look for leak stains
inspect.alt2: Number 02, walls: watch for cracks and damp
inspect.alt3: Number 03, water and power: make sure both work safely
inspect.alt4: Number 04, legal papers: match the certificate and building permit
inspect.alt5: Closing: inspect the house with a RE/MAX agent

steps.title: 5 steps to your first home
steps.alt0: Cover: Buying your first home? Follow these 5 steps
steps.alt1: Step 1: set a budget, keep mortgage payments under 30% of income
steps.alt3: Step 3: check the condition of the house
steps.alt4: Step 4: make sure the legal papers are in order
steps.alt5: Closing: 5 simple steps to your first home, talk to a RE/MAX agent

sume.title: Carousels published for SUME
sume.body: Two explainer series on backup power and data center efficiency, made with Carousely and posted on their Instagram. Swipe to see every slide.

ups.title: Keeping UPS batteries ready
ups.alt0: Cover: You have a UPS, but are its batteries ready? UPS batteries carry the load until the genset takes over
ups.alt1: The first seconds run on battery: when grid power fails, the UPS battery kicks in before the genset starts
ups.alt2: Why UPS batteries fail: hot rooms, a 3–5 year service life, frequent use
ups.alt4: Routine UPS battery maintenance: regular checks, a clean environment, performance tests, a replacement plan
ups.alt5: Closing: keep your backup power ready, talk to the SUME team

pue.title: Lowering data center PUE
pue.alt0: Cover: What is your data center’s PUE?
pue.alt1: What PUE is: total facility energy divided by IT equipment energy
pue.alt2: The global average PUE is around 1.5
pue.alt3: Where energy gets wasted: no containment, temperature set points too low, overcapacity, unoptimized operations
pue.alt4: 4 steps to lower PUE: containment, tuned temperature settings, right-sized capacity, routine monitoring
pue.alt5: Closing: efficiency starts with measurement, book an efficiency audit with the SUME team
